paper_title: Precision Metrology Meets Cosmology: Improved Constraints on Ultralight Dark Matter from Atom-Cavity Frequency Comparisons
coupling_convention: dimensionless d_e (electromagnetic gauge modulus, Damour-Donoghue convention)
notes: Paper reports new measured 95% CL limits on ultralight dilatonic DM couplings from Sr clock / Si cavity / H-maser frequency ratio comparisons at JILA, over masses ~1e-21 to ~1e-16 eV (extended to ~1e-14 eV via dynamical decoupling). Primary result constrains d_e (fine-structure constant modulus, ScalarPhoton); also constrains d_me (ScalarElectron, improved by up to factor 100 between 2e-21 and 2e-19 eV, ~4e-5 at lowest masses) and d_mhat (quark mass, supplementary). No numerical table available; data_points are approximate values read from Fig. 2(a) axis ranges and text statements (new bound 1e-19 to 1e-17 eV; spectroscopy improvements to 4.5e-16 eV), so they should be treated as order-of-magnitude estimates of the exclusion envelope. Assumes local DM density 0.3 GeV/cm^3 and includes stochastic-amplitude rescaling factor ~3.0. Confidence reduced because multiple couplings are constrained and numerical values are figure-derived approximations. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 3, 0, 0.5, 5))
